conclusion.determination: 20:12 insufficient parity reserve is the dominant observed 5305 cause; not a universal physical 30% packet-loss ceiling nor proof of an FEC decoder correctness bug.
conclusion.explanation: In IID 30% erasure and complete 20-source blocks, FEC20:12 source residual 5.772424% vs FEC20:20 0.130108%; 20:20 size classes and partial flush mean full-block reference cannot be applied directly to all packets.
conclusion.metrics: Compared seed1508, identical source and netns setup: app loss 6.308/6.498% -> 0.205/0.151%; probe 56/60 and returned p99 2178.685ms ->60/60 and 612.790ms. Normal traffic 10Mbps each direction maintained.
conclusion.limited_shadow: FEC20:20 sends ~6581 outer fresh packets/sec vs 5265 with20:12. At 600ms RTT, nominal outstanding ~3949 vs3159 records, approaching the intentional 4096 optional retransmission shadow cap. Tx abandoned ~116k each direction tracks optional repair protection, not delivered app loss; investigate if lower-resource recovery tuning desired, no blanket increase of memory cap.
conclusion.cpu: Single hosted-run process CPU seconds ~83.6 vs66.6 client/server; resource overhead indicative, not a multi-run CPU qualification.
conclusion.uncertainty: Only one 20:20 matched sample and 60 stress probes; cannot guarantee rare latency tail across seeds, burst losses, physical ARM AF_PACKET, MTU9000/IP fragmentation, physical 1800s or full70/final18. Do not infer ARM physical resolution.
